subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this issue finish with documentation/help for the existing bindings, or also add a public configurable TUI submit/newline preference?
rationale: Multiline composition already works through the dependency, while configuration would expand OpenClaw’s public config/CLI surface and upgrade obligations.

options.title: Document existing bindings
options.body: Add TUI help and docs for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter without new configuration.

options.title: Add configurable bindings
options.body: Define a backward-compatible TUI submit/newline preference with schema, help, persistence, and focused tests.

recommendation.title: Document existing bindings
recommendation.body: Add TUI help and docs for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter without new configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete’s history covers the TUI wrapper, dependency integration, docs, and the prior product-scope review.
